deliverables.text: Browse NYC-area races from several organizers and filter by distance, road vs. trail, location, race date and registration status
deliverables.note: Home page search and chips; location is matched through the race/park/organizer text search.

deliverables.text: Sort by race date, registration opening date, entry deadline, or distance
deliverables.note: This cycle built next deadline and race day sorts; opening-date and distance sorts are not built yet.

deliverables.text: Support common and custom distances, including ultramarathons
deliverables.note: 5K to marathon buckets plus an Ultra bucket; the sample set includes a trail 50K.

deliverables.text: Race detail page with date, location, distance, terrain, organizer, price and official registration link
deliverables.note: Out of scope for this home-page cycle; the data model already stores price and registration links.

deliverables.text: Distinguish open registration, lotteries, time qualification, charity and membership entry, with qualification windows per edition
deliverables.note: Entry method is stored per edition and the Lottery chip uses it; the other methods and qualification windows have no UI yet.

deliverables.text: Highlight registration status: opening soon, open, lottery open, waitlist, sold out, closed
deliverables.note: Status label on every row, plus a highlight for deadlines within three weeks.

deliverables.text: Save races as Interested, Considering or Signed up
deliverables.note: Needs accounts; the page says accounts are not live yet.

deliverables.text: My Races view with upcoming races, registration milestones, notes and status changes
deliverables.note: Needs accounts; only a labelled example season timeline is shown.

deliverables.text: Reminders for registration openings and deadlines with custom times and presets
deliverables.note: Scheduled reminders need a notification integration; nothing implies one is scheduled.

deliverables.text: Downloadable calendar events for registration milestones and race day, working in Apple Calendar and Outlook
deliverables.note: An .ics file for the next milestone (Add to calendar) and for race day via the API.

deliverables.text: Prioritise Google Calendar for adding events
deliverables.note: The .ics file imports into Google Calendar; a one-click Google Calendar link is not built yet.

deliverables.text: Show times in America/New_York and keep the correct time zone in exports
deliverables.note: All times are shown in ET; exports use UTC so every calendar converts correctly.

deliverables.text: Show official source links and last-verified dates, label unknown or tentative dates, and keep each annual edition separate
deliverables.note: Editions are separate and unknown or tentative dates are labelled; source links and last-verified dates are stored but not shown yet.

deliverables.text: Energetic, editorial, mobile-friendly visual design with accessible contrast
deliverables.note: Built from mockup 12, checked at phone width.

deliverables.text: A focused, clearly labelled sample set of NYC-area races across distances, terrain, organizers and entry methods
deliverables.note: Seven sample races, labelled on the page and in the README.

deliverables.text: Make clear which features work and which need more integrations
deliverables.note: Accounts, saving and sign-up are marked as not live.
